scenes: Is heat the same across a whole city?
No. It can differ sharply from one ward to the next. | So some cities map risk ward by ward.
Thane, next to Mumbai, scored each ward on felt heat, warm nights and social vulnerability, | and a heatwave task force across departments runs the plan.
Send help where the heat hits hardest.
